newsitem.title: SUDAN: Sudan says it seized rebel camp, killed 10.
newsitem.headline: Sudan says it seized rebel camp, killed 10.

text.p: The Sudanese army said on Monday it had captured a camp of the rebel Sudan People's Liberation Army in southern Sudan.

State run Radio Omdurman quoted army spokesman Lieutenant General Mohammad al-Sanousi Ahmad as saying the army on Sunday "seized control of Kergulu camp of the SPLA", in Yei river province, near the Ugandan border.
It quoted him as saying 10 rebels were killed and 30 guns seized.
The report could not be independently confirmed.

SPLA-led Sudanese rebels, bent on toppling the Islamist government of Khartoum, launched an offensive across Sudan's eastern and southern borders more than a month ago. Sudan has accused Ethiopia and Eritrea of backing the offensive, which both countries deny.
